TotalMedicinalIngredients.definition: Total units of medicinal ingredients available to produce pills

RequiredMedicinal.definition: Units of medicinal ingredients required to produce one unit of pill type i

RequiredFiller.definition: Units of filler required to produce one unit of pill type i

MinimumPills.definition: Minimum number of pills that must be produced for pill type i

MinimumProportion.definition: Minimum proportion of total pills that must be of pill type i
